Molycop FY26 revenue remains inferred from disclosed volume and FY25 realization; newer FY26 EBITDA/volume and management guidance take precedence over the older USD1540m/172m snapshot.
Net debt already reflects preference-funded refinancing and the new parent acquisition loan. No second debt paydown or second loan addition.
Forecast needs additional funding; availability and pricing are not confirmed.

inputs._note: Platform cost-of-capital method (docs/COST_OF_CAPITAL.md): WACC = unlevered cost of capital - debt weight x tax rate x pre-tax cost of debt. Risk-free = 10-year G-sec 6.9754% on 2 September 2026 less India's 1.87% default spread; ERP = India total 7.08% (Damodaran, January 2026); unlevered beta = Machinery, corrected for cash, 0.89 (Damodaran, January 2026). Debt weight 12.81% from the industry's 14.69% D/E, because the pre-deal balance sheet held acquisition funding. Debt cost = FY2025-FY2026 borrowing interest paid 355.56 / average borrowings 5,423.08 (audited statements). Tax uses the existing FY24-FY26 effective-rate proxy.
inputs._regression_beta_note: The 0.6749 weekly regression beta in tega_capm_reference_20260902.json has R-squared 0.05 (standard error about 0.29) and is kept only as a cross-check.

inputs._note: Platform cost-of-capital method in USD: WACC = unlevered cost of capital - debt weight x tax rate x pre-tax cost of debt. Risk-free = 10-year US Treasury 4.79% on 2 September 2026; ERP = mature-market 4.23% (Damodaran, January 2026), with no operating-country premium added because Molycop's revenue by country is not in the sources. Unlevered beta = Steel, corrected for cash, 0.94 (Damodaran, January 2026). Debt weight 48.11% = term loan INR66,479m at close / the USD1,455m deal EV. The Apollo preference shares earn no tax shield, so they do not change the WACC; their claim is deducted in the equity bridge. No premium is added; see _transaction_premium_note for the deal-price cross-check. STILL UNSOURCED: 9% debt cost (contractual rates not disclosed) and 27% tax.
inputs._transaction_premium_note: Zero: Molycop uses industry inputs only (decision of 27 October 2026). This values Molycop at about 1.9 times the INR142,455m headline EV paid at the 1 June 2026 close. The report shows the deal-calibrated alternative as a cross-check: a premium of about 3.4% over CAPM (WACC about 11.0%) makes the base-case Molycop DCF equal the price paid. Such a premium would stand for risk the US steel beta and mature-market ERP omit: B+ credit, private ownership and emerging-market mines (the earnout depends on Cobre Panama and Grasberg).

policy.scope: Only previously unresolved legacy Tega statement lines. Existing operating, tax, debt and asset assumptions have priority. Molycop forecasts are unchanged.
policy.historical_other_income: FY25 effective interest yield on average FY24/FY25 cash and bank balances, applied to opening forecast cash. FY25 avoids the FY26 acquisition funding cash build-up. Miscellaneous receipts use the FY25/FY26 nominal average.
policy.historical_jv: FY24-FY26 average annual equity-accounted profit and cash dividend, prorated to the forecast period. Dividends cannot exceed the available JV carrying value.
policy.tax: Existing historical effective rate on positive taxable income; JV share of profit is already after JV tax. Deferred tax movements and incremental tax on subsidiary/JV distributions are zero modeling assumptions, not verified tax exemptions.
policy.balance_sheet: Keep non-operating historical balances at FY26 nominal values unless a schedule determines them. Roll equity from reported FY26 equity plus reported Q1 legacy PAT, then forecast PAT less dividends. No equity or cash balancing plug.
policy.asset_detail: Allocate the existing pooled asset cohorts into PPE, ROU and intangibles using reported opening balances and FY26 additions mix. Preserve aggregate depreciation and capex exactly; split pooled CWIP into tangible and intangible construction.
policy.debt_detail: Allocate scheduled principal using historical lease/principal proportions, sweep bank debt before leases, and classify the next annual scheduled payments as current. Additional required funding is a current facility proxy; term borrowing becomes current within the existing parent-loan maturity window. This is a classification proxy, not contractual repayment guidance.
policy.dividend_timing: One annual payment in July-March FY27; unchanged INR2/share annually thereafter. FY27 follows the proposed FY26 dividend; later years are a historical fallback.
policy.opening_reconciliation: Keep the previously approved estimated June cash/debt bridge. Show any difference from the independently rolled FY26 opening balance sheet as a diagnostic; never fill it with a plug or call it zero.
policy.molycop_investment: Show the existing parent cash contribution at cost solely in this legacy-only statement view. Existing subsidiary cash distributions are dividend income here; do not add the investment or dividend to group FCFF/DCF again.

legacy_statement_assumptions.retained_balance_rule: Zero forecast movement does not erase an opening asset or liability.
legacy_statement_assumptions.double_counting_rule: Subsidiary/JV investment balances and dividends are not added to group FCFF or DCF a second time.

historical_driver_calculations.method: Arithmetic mean of available annual ratios; closing-balance/sales convention. FY26 transaction costs removed from operating cost mix only. Tax is unadjusted total accounting tax / PBT, a cash-tax proxy rather than a statutory marginal tax rate.

consensus_review.use: Comparison only. Public summary has no detailed segment/expense/BS/CF estimates, definitions or individual report dates. Do not override approved revenue or backsolve expenses from headline profit.
consensus_review.wacc_status: No publicly verifiable analyst consensus WACC found for the enlarged group. A single provider discount-rate estimate is not consensus.
consensus_review.access_limits: Broker list exposed old reports; Alpha Spread and MarketScreener pages were not accessible. Absence of a verified public estimate does not mean none exists in paid research.

Average FY24-FY26 normalized cost shares allocate the margin-driven expense envelope; subtract FY26 transaction expense from historical other expense. This is an allocation, not independent component guidance.
4% growth over comparable ten months; actual comparable ten-month earnings unavailable, so use FY26 EBITDA times 10/12 and remove reported June.
Flat core profit per tonne following management approach; INR1899.4m cost-saving target in 2-2.5 years. Annual ramp/run-rate interpretation is modeled; first-year savings already in 4% guidance.

historical_drivers.method: Arithmetic mean of available annual ratios; closing-balance/sales convention. FY26 transaction costs removed from operating cost mix only. Tax is unadjusted total accounting tax / PBT, a cash-tax proxy rather than a statutory marginal tax rate.

guidance_comparisons.margin_definition_note: Model operating margin excludes other income. Management adjusted EBITDA may include it. Compare as a diagnostic; never plug earnings to force 15%.

consensus_review.use: Comparison only. Public summary has no detailed segment/expense/BS/CF estimates, definitions or individual report dates. Do not override approved revenue or backsolve expenses from headline profit.
consensus_review.wacc_status: No publicly verifiable analyst consensus WACC found for the enlarged group. A single provider discount-rate estimate is not consensus.
consensus_review.access_limits: Broker list exposed old reports; Alpha Spread and MarketScreener pages were not accessible. Absence of a verified public estimate does not mean none exists in paid research.

scenario_assumptions.rationale: Approved upside revenue path. Consumables margin uses the management range; equipment margin and legacy working capital/capex use audited historical ratios. Molycop FY27 EBITDA follows 4% guidance in every case; later core profit per tonne stays flat, with an explicit savings ramp. Later capex scales with revenue after the two-year guidance window. Unverified acquisition/financing inputs remain provisional.
scenario_assumptions.group_valuation_rationale: 100% pro-forma operating consolidation; blended standalone WACC; full senior claims and explicit ordinary NCI deduction.

shared_assumptions.opening_bridge_rationale: June legacy cash is estimated. Q1 CFO after interest = one quarter of FY24-FY26 average (not reported Q1 CFO); Q1 principal is one quarter of March current maturities. Q1 capex/commissioning and other cash remain unresolved timing estimates.
shared_assumptions.asset_rationale: Legacy March assets are rolled forward with assumed Q1 commissioning and reported Q1 D&A. Molycop annual D&A starts at June D&A x 12, split between the provisional intangible base / assumed 15-year life and a residual existing-asset charge; that residual is capitalized over 8 assumed remaining years. These are modeling asset balances, not reported PPE. No goodwill amortization or unverified acquisition tax shield.
shared_assumptions.molycop_other_claims_rationale: Provisional reserve of INR4,748.50m converted from the source-currency proxy at the selected rate. Includes unallocated lease/pension/other claims and lower-level minority/JV uncertainty; not a verified fair value or a second deduction of Apollo ordinary equity. Sensitivity uses INR0/4,748.50/9,497.00m. Reconcile net-debt scope before replacement.
shared_assumptions.preference_rationale: INR25,641.90m issue value is a provisional June-end fair-value proxy. Contractual return, redemption premium and exit rights are not quantified in the reviewed filings. The 12% PIK/cash schedule is an analyst stress assumption, NOT a disclosed coupon. Perpetual instrument: no invented mandatory redemption. DCF deducts today's claim once; future PIK is not subtracted again from FCFF.
shared_assumptions.financing_rationale: FY27 legacy finance cost follows the INR1100-1200m management range, less reported Q1 expense; treated as cash interest provisionally. Later interest applies its implied annual rate to opening debt. Molycop FY27 interest + principal totals management INR6647.90m; INR5983.11m/664.79m split remains unverified. Subtract reported June interest instead of counting it again. Later Molycop 9% net-debt interest proxy, 70% retention, and lease repayment remain unresolved.
shared_assumptions.tax_rationale: Legacy 24.4558% = FY24-FY26 mean total accounting tax / PBT; used as an explicit cash-tax proxy, not a forecast of current/deferred taxes or a marginal rate. Molycop 27% is still an unresolved model input: no verified guidance/consensus/standalone tax history. No cross-border loss offsets.
shared_assumptions.pending_issue_rationale: Main pro-forma valuation includes follow-on shares and matching unreceived cash once; legal issuance completion remains unverified.
shared_assumptions.discount_rate_rationale: Entity CAPM/financing inputs and EV weights are in pro_forma.wacc; see their source/proxy notes.
